description: Header file defining string utility functions for the Starboard platform, including string formatting, hex encoding, string copying, concatenation, and splitting.

methods.name: FormatString
methods.description: Formats a string using printf-style formatting and returns the result as std::string.

methods.name: HexEncode
methods.description: Encodes binary data into a hexadecimal string, optionally separated by a delimiter.

methods.name: strlcpy
methods.description: Copies a string with size limit, ensuring null termination, similar to strlcpy in BSD.

methods.name: strlcat
methods.description: Concatenates strings with size limit, similar to strlcat in BSD.

methods.name: SplitString
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on a delimiter character.
